name: Humanity
overview: Scripture reveals that humanity is uniquely created in the image and likeness of God, as seen in Genesis 1:26-27, affirming both male and female as bearers of His divine image. God formed man from the dust and breathed life into him, making him a living soul (Genesis 2:7). Despite man's noble creation, his heart is naturally inclined toward evil from youth (Genesis 8:21), yet God values humanity greatly, providing for them and declaring them more precious than the birds of the air (Matthew 6:26). The psalmist acknowledges the marvelous and fearfully made nature of human beings, underscoring the intentional and wondrous work of God in humanity (Psalms 139:14).
